title: Meme Trojan: Backdoor Attacks Against Hateful Meme Detection via Cross-Modal Triggers
reasoning: The paper focuses on a security-oriented backdoor attack (Meme Trojan) and defense analysis within the context of hateful meme detection. While the datasets used include memes targeting religious groups (e.g., Jewish and Islamic faiths) and the study discusses hatefulness as a social concept, it does not benchmark or evaluate religious systems, theological frameworks, or moral reasoning in a formal capacity.
